subject: Audit scope & cross-border export controls — SOC 2 Type II evidence request
messages:
From: Oliver Hughes <oliver.hughes@bucklandbank.co.uk>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00Z
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + hosting region questions

Hi Mina,

We are moving towards procurement for the Redwood integration and need to complete our compliance intake. Two quick asks:

1) Can you provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and confirm the audit period it covers? Our security team needs dates to map to our procurement window.

2) For UK-resident data, can you confirm where production model inference and persistent customer data are hosted? We need explicit confirmation of regional controls (compute + object storage) and any paths where data may cross into non-UK/EU control planes or support tooling.

Also: we may require a short bridge/attestation letter that covers the gap between your last SOC 2 period and the current one — please confirm if you can provide that and the typical signing/timeline.

Can you loop in a compliance contact or legal if needed?

Thanks,
Oliver Hughes
Head of Vendor Risk, Buckland Bank
oliver.hughes@bucklandbank.co.uk
+44 20 7123 4567

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Hughes <oliver.hughes@bucklandbank.co.uk>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + hosting region questions

Hi Oliver — thanks for the note and congrats on getting this far.

Quick answers up front: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter. I've cc'd Vanessa (security/compliance lead) and Rishi (legal) to confirm specifics. A few clarifying Qs so we give exactly what you need:

- What date range do you need covered by the bridge letter (e.g., between last report end and procurement signature)?
- Do you need the report redacted, or are you able to accept the standard PDF we provide to customers under NDA?
- Is your team specifically requesting an attestation about cross-border transfer mechanisms (SCCs/UK Addendum), or a more detailed data flow diagram for review?

I included our standard attachments (SOC2 and an editable bridge-letter template) below — Vanessa, can you confirm the audit window and whether any processing logs (egress/replication events) are needed for their review?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Oliver Hughes <oliver.hughes@bucklandbank.co.uk>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T08:46:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + hosting region questions

On Mon, Apr 11, 2027 at 09:12, Oliver Hughes <oliver.hughes@bucklandbank.co.uk> wrote:
> We are moving towards procurement for the Redwood integration and need to complete our compliance intake. Two quick asks:
>
> 1) Can you provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and confirm the audit period it covers?
> 2) For UK-resident data, can you confirm where production model inference and persistent customer data are hosted?

Hi Oliver,

Thanks for the clear list. Short summary and attachments below — attaching: SOC2_TypeII_2026-10-01_2027-03-31.pdf, our bridge letter template (editable), and a simplified network/data-flow diagram.

- SOC 2 Type II: the latest report covers 2026-10-01 through 2027-03-31. We provide the report under an NDA; redacted copies can be produced on request.

- Hosting & data residency: production inference and customer persistent objects (S3-backed storage for artifacts and logs) may be pinned to customer-chosen regions. For UK customers we offer a UK region deployment option (aws-eu-west-2 / London) where inference compute, object storage, and KV caches reside.

- Control plane & support tooling: our control plane (management/rollouts/observability) runs in a separate, multiregional control infrastructure. For UK-hosted deployments, control plane metadata is logically separated and encrypted in transit; we can enable a private-control-plane option for on-prem or VPC-based private deployments to eliminate cross-region control-plane calls.

- Cross-border transfers: for customers accepting Hosted/Standard deployments we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) with the UK Addendum where applicable, and for Dedicated/Private deployments we can sign the UK International Data Transfer Addendum (IDTA) as required. We do not perform routine replication of customer inference payloads to the US.

- Operational exceptions that may result in limited, logged transfers for troubleshooting: in rare cases (eg, customer-authorized debug sessions or emergency incident response) limited log excerpts or snapshots may be transferred to our on-call SREs in another region. These are logged and covered by our access controls; we can provide a sample anonymized log export for review.

Bridge letter:
- We can provide a signed bridge letter that attests coverage for the period between 2027-04-01 and the start of the next Type II report (we typically issue these for up to 6 months), or tailor it to the exact dates you require.
- Typical timeline: draft returned within 2 business days, signed copy within 4 business days after DocuSign.

Attachments included: SOC2_TypeII_2026-10-01_2027-03-31.pdf (redacted available), redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx, network-data-flow-diagram-v2.png

If Buckland requires:
- a) an explicit data-flow mapping for specific buckets/keys we can export a short CSV listing of any cross-region replication rules that reference your account, or
- b) a signed IDTA/SCC worksheet, Rishi can coordinate legal redlines.

Let me know the exact bridge dates and whether you want the private-control-plane option documented in the letter.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

From: Oliver Hughes <oliver.hughes@bucklandbank.co.uk>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@bucklandbank.co.uk>
Date: 2027-04-13T14:08:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + hosting region questions

Thanks — this is helpful.

Buckland would like the bridge letter to explicitly cover 2027-04-01 through 2027-06-30. Please produce the signed version via DocuSign and include a short paragraph confirming that, for our account, no active replication to non-UK regions is configured and that routine support transfers are logged and limited to anonymized debug snapshots unless we provide explicit consent.

Also: please attach the redacted SOC2 PDF for our risk team and a short CSV listing any replication rules for the buckets we will provide (I'll send the bucket list in a follow-up). Timeline: we need the signed bridge letter by 2027-04-18 to proceed with procurement.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Oliver
Head of Vendor Risk, Buckland Bank
summary: Customer requested SOC 2 Type II and a bridge letter covering April–June 2027; internal team provided report dates and described hosting, control-plane, and cross-border options; customer requested signed DocuSign bridge and redacted report by 2027-04-18.
